title: --renew-before-expiration-duration is deprecated in 1.2 and removed in 1.3

detection.reason: checked in the cert-manager workload's container args only — a flag passed through a config file is not scanned

quote: The `--renew-before-expiration-duration` flag of the cert-manager controller-manager has been deprecated. Please set the `Certificate.Spec.RenewBefore` field instead. This flag will be removed in the next release.
remediation: Drop the flag from the controller's args and set `spec.renewBefore` on the Certificates that relied on it.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy,ds -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | .metadata as $m | .spec.template.spec.containers[].args[]? | select(test("renew-before-expiration-duration")) | "\($m.namespace)/\($m.name) \(.)"'  # each row is a controller still started with the flag; NO rows = clean
